description: A district curriculum director must approve the design and funding plan for an elementary outdoor learning garden, including its location, instructional configuration, safety measures, and purchasing method, with input from school staff responsible for facilities, garden instruction, health, and grants.

shared_context.S1: The district plans to establish an outdoor learning garden for grades 3 through 5 at Oak Ridge Elementary.
shared_context.S2: The draft proposal places the garden in the West Courtyard with six soil beds, one open compost tumbler, flowering plants, and a student water station.
shared_context.S3: The draft proposal estimates a total materials cost of $3,200 and lists the general fund as the source.
shared_context.S4: Dr. Vega has authority to approve the final garden design, safety plan, and funding method.
shared_context.S5: At the design meeting, the facilities manager, garden coordinator, school nurse, and grants coordinator each review the proposal aloud before Dr. Vega makes the final call.
shared_context.S6: District review protocol requires the approving officer to make the final call during the scheduled meeting using the information reviewed there; documentation or follow-up tasks assigned after the meeting do not delay that approval.
shared_context.S7: Dr. Vega must not settle until each participant has been invited to share any updates and has either issued a reveal action or explicitly confirmed that they have no additional information to disclose.

PF1.text: A facilities soil test completed this week found contamination in the West Courtyard; district grounds policy requires the garden to move to the East Courtyard and use sealed raised beds there. Mr. Brooks received the lab report after the draft proposal was circulated and has not yet updated the site plan.

PF2.text: The grade 3 through 5 lesson sequence finalized this week requires exactly four raised beds and two lidded compost bins for the planned rotations. Ms. Green completed the sequence after the draft was written and has not yet entered the equipment changes in the proposal.

PF3.text: Two participating students have documented severe contact reactions to latex and soil-borne irritants. The health plan requires nitrile gloves for student use and a handwashing station located within 10 feet of the beds. Nurse Okafor confirmed these requirements against the student health records this week but has not added them to the garden draft.

PF4.text: The awarded garden grant covers exactly $3,200 of eligible materials, and the grant agreement requires all garden materials to be purchased through a grant purchase order rather than the general fund. Mr. Cho reviewed the executed award this week and has not yet attached it to the proposal.

acceptance_conditions: The garden must be located in the East Courtyard.
The garden must use sealed raised beds.
The final design must contain exactly four raised beds.
The final design must contain exactly two lidded compost bins.
A handwashing station must be located no more than 10 feet from the beds.
The materials budget must be exactly $3,200.
Materials must be purchased through a grant purchase order.
A formal garden safety implementation commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C2: decisions['bed_type'] == 'sealed raised beds' or decisions['bed_type'] == 'Sealed raised beds' or decisions['bed_type'] == 'SEALED RAISED BEDS'
content_checks.C5: decisions['student_glove_type'] == 'nitrile' or decisions['student_glove_type'] == 'nitrile gloves' or decisions['student_glove_type'] == 'Nitrile' or decisions['student_glove_type'] == 'Nitrile gloves' or decisions['student_glove_type'] == 'NITRILE' or decisions['student_glove_type'] == 'NITRILE GLOVES'
content_checks.C8: 'grant' in decisions['funding_source'] and 'purchase order' in decisions['funding_source']
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] in ['documentation_update', 'health_compliance', 'safety_compliance', 'safety_implementation', 'health_safety'] and ('nitrile' in c['detail'] or 'Nitrile' in c['detail']) and ('handwashing' in c['detail'] or 'hand washing' in c['detail'] or 'Handwashing' in c['detail'] or 'Hand washing' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The soil-test result changes the site from West Courtyard to East Courtyard and changes the beds from ordinary soil beds to sealed raised beds.
The finalized lesson sequence changes the design from six beds and one compost tumbler to exactly four raised beds and two lidded compost bins.
The student health requirements change glove selection to nitrile, set the handwashing distance at no more than 10 feet, and require a formal safety implementation commitment.
The executed grant changes the funding method from the general fund to a grant purchase order and fixes the eligible materials budget at exactly $3,200.
